thread:
maya: Heads up — canary rollout for ingest v2 is showing duplicated ack counts around watermark boundaries.
jordan: repro steps?
maya: quick summary: when the hourly watermark advances at :00 the ack-window TTL expiry coincides with consumer retry, causing two acks for same session id to make it past dedupe.
ash: ugh. does this only hit canary streams?
maya: so far in canary (1% traffic) only for flows that have bursty retries and session flush at watermark. logs attached: ```json
{"event_id":"evt_9xk","consumer":"ingest-consumer-2","ack":true,"ack_seq":42}
```
liam: can you paste the patch that caused the TTL change?
maya: this PR bumped lease_ttl from 55s -> 65s to reduce false negatives; looks like combined with our retry backoff it crosses the hourly boundary for some shards.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy  ingestor-v2 started at 1728883300
jordan: fix options: 1) revert TTL change 2) add ack_sequence idempotency header 3) make dedupe window anchored to event_id+watermark rather than ttl.
ash: idempotency header is safest long-term. short-term revert might be fastest rollback to stop billing noise.
liam: how bad is the billing noise? numbers?
maya: in canary approx 0.2% of acks duplicated -> shows as +0.15% token delta on invoice-preview. small but spikes on some tenants.
jordan: dashboard items to add: "ingest.acks.duplicate_rate", "ingest.acks.pending_at_watermark", and a debug card for last-ack-sequence per-event.
ash: also instrument the commit ordering: `commit_token` in the ack payload. then dedupe can be exact.
maya: sample payload we could accept: ```json
{"event_id":"evt_9xk","commit_token":"c_2024_09_01_1728","ack_seq":42}
```
liam: rollout plan: revert TTL in canary now, push idempotency header change behind FF, enable FF for 1% then 10% then 100% with shadow mode for 24h before switching billing path.
jordan: agree. add alert: if ingest.acks.duplicate_rate > 0.5% for 5m -> page oncall.
maya: I'll open the revert PR and the idempotency PR. tagging @ash for telemetry dashboard work.
ash: I'll add the three metrics and a small Grafana panel in the per-tenant billing dashboard. also add logs: `ingest.acks.debug` with short sampling to avoid cost.
ingest-bot: sample event ack: evt_9xk commit=c_2024_09_01_1728 dup=false
maya: thanks. can we also add a canary-only invoice-preview export so finance can see impact without affecting live invoices?
jordan: yes — create preview export to s3 with canary tag. finance will consume.
liam: timeline: revert within 30m -> monitor for 1h -> merge idempotency FF behind shadow within 6h -> promote after 24h if clean.
maya: on it. I'll post PR links when ready.
jordan: :thumbsup: keep updates minimal in thread, we don't need a rollup until PRs are up.
maya: noted. starting revert PR now.
